svg.title: Framework Upgrades at Scale — Platform-Level Operating Model (End-to-End)

g.text: Framework Upgrades at Scale — Platform-Level Operating Model (End-to-End)
- Patch upgrades can auto-merge with green CI
- Minor upgrades are grouped into waves
- Major upgrades require explicit windows and comms
- No upgrade merges without CI gates
- CI failure rate after baseline change
+ Predictable upgrades and lower coordination cost
Patch: continuous | Minor: waves | Major: explicit windows
